kotlin.label: Loop
kotlin.code:
fun findMissingNumberFrom1ToN(input: List<Int>): Int {
    val n = input.size + 1
    var missing = 0
    for (candidate in 1..n) missing = missing xor candidate
    for (value in input) missing = missing xor value
    return missing
}
kotlin.note: Good to try: the explicit loop is easy to reason about, which makes it a strong backup when the interviewer wants to see every step.
